discovery: Discovery of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and its physiological role, leading to GLP-1-based therapies for diabetes and obesity
rationale: GLP-1 biology has transformed the treatment of type 2 diabetes and obesity and shown broad cardiovascular and renal benefits. The discovery has collected major precursor awards (Lasker 2024, Breakthrough Prize 2025, Gairdner), and the field is now mature enough for the Nobel. The 2025 prize went to immunology (regulatory T cells), which leaves room for a metabolic/endocrine topic.
